Clay and Webflow Integration

Clay and Webflow Integration [...] Unbounce personalizes keywords. GenPage personalizes for people.  
This is the key distinction. Unbounce’s Dynamic Text Replacement swaps a word or phrase based on a URL parameter. Someone searches “project management for agencies,” and the headline reflects that. It’s useful for aligning ad copy with landing pages, but it doesn’t account for who the visitor actually is - their company, industry, or specific context. It’s keyword-level personalization. [...] Instead of swapping a word on an existing page, GenPage generates a unique landing page per keyword group or audience - stronger message match, better Quality Scores, higher conversion rates.

Unlimited users from Pro

Invite your entire team at no extra cost and manage multiple clients in separate workspaces on Scale, from $249/mo. Create and share unlimited sub-workspaces with clients, with pages, leads, and analytics fully isolated - no custom plan required.

### Unbounce vs GenPage: which one to choose

Ask where your landing pages are going. If they’re receiving inbound or paid traffic and your focus is optimizing conversion rates through A/B testing, Unbounce is built for that.
